items.description: Free food at Interfaith Food Bank of Amador County. Schedule: Mon 12 PM–4 PM; Tue–Wed 11 AM–3 PM; Thu 2 PM–6 PM. Eligibility: seniors 60+ first two weeks; EFAP recipients 3rd & 4th weeks. Call (209) 267-9006 to confirm before you go — hours change and supplies can run out. Source: community research, Oct 2026.
